evidence_kind: synthetic task inputs; no real empirical claims

cases.brief: Write a 300-450 word project memo explaining the research problem, investigatory question, proposed comparison, stakeholder concern, evaluation limits and expected contribution. Hold work conditions constant while varying representation; preserve unresolved questions.
checks: Problem leads to question, method, evaluation and contribution
No settled definition invented for S4

cases.brief: Write an annotated synthesis of S1-S4. Give each source identity, what it supports, its limits, and its relationship to the others. Conclude with the unresolved evidence needs.
checks: S2 and S3 measure different outcomes

cases.brief: Produce an argument and evidence outline for a short conceptual and pilot paper. Map proposed claims to S1-S4, distinguish contribution from results, and identify the evidence needed before stronger claims are defensible.
checks: Every substantive proposed claim has a source or evidence-needed marker

cases.brief: Write a 500-700 word draft with problem, method, observations, limitations and contribution. Cite supplied source IDs and paragraph locators. Present the pilot counts accurately without causal, population-wide or pooled effects.
checks: Counts remain three of four and two of four
Arrival-order assignment and missing timing are retained
S3 is not pooled with S2

cases.brief: Repair unsupported claims and grammar only within the Requested revision section, using S1-S4. Preserve every byte outside that section, including realizational Agent and the open research question.
checks: Superiority and validated-scale claims are removed or explicitly qualified

cases.brief: Review the supplied draft against S1-S4. Provide locator-bound findings, justified severity, proposed remedies and a whole-document comprehension assessment. Identify unsupported claims while preserving the valid open question. Give a bounded readiness judgment without granting research acceptance.
checks: Unsupported superiority, corroboration and scale claims are found
Protected open question is not treated as a defect
No acceptance or lifecycle terminal authority is invented
